description: The chart illustrates the composition of two horizontal stacked bars in terms of three labeled components—“Context,” “Generated Response,” and “Other”—with each component shown as a percentage of the total bar. The category axis is vertical, showing two rows: the lower row is labeled “Standard,” while the upper row appears as an unlabeled category (its label area is blank/obscured). The value axis is horizontal and represents percentage share across each bar; no explicit axis label, numeric tick marks, or scale markings are visible, but each bar spans a full 0–100% width as indicated by the internal percentage annotations. Each stacked bar is divided into three colored segments corresponding to the legend at the bottom: blue for “Context,” orange for “Generated Response,” and green for “Other.” In the upper (unlabeled) bar, the blue “Context” segment is annotated as 60.6%, the orange “Generated Response” segment as 31.7%, and the green “Other” segment as 7.7%. In the “Standard” bar, the blue “Context” segment is 23.6%, the orange “Generated Response” segment is 51.1%, and the green “Other” segment is 25.3%. The stacks are arranged left-to-right in the same order (Context, then Generated Response, then Other) for both categories, and there is no visible sorting cue beyond the two-category vertical arrangement; no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the in-segment percentage labels.
